_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Underwater#000.src: Talk to Omango located at the North of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Underwater#000.dst: {p} の北 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] にいる Omango と話す

Underwater#001.src: Hi, my name is Omango. I am a resident of the {p} village, on top of the hill.
Underwater#001.dst: やあ、私は Omango。丘の上の {p} 村の住人だ。
Underwater#001.speaker: Omango

Underwater#002.src: As you may know, our people came to your land years ago, and this is the ship they used.
Underwater#002.dst: 知っているかもしれないが、私たちの民は昔この地へ渡ってきた。これがその時の船だ。
Underwater#002.speaker: Omango

Underwater#003.src: They brought lots of luxurious goods with them. Most of them got lost in the wreck.
Underwater#003.dst: 彼らは贅沢品を大量に持ってきたが、ほとんどは難破で失われた。
Underwater#003.speaker: Omango

Underwater#004.src: But recently, a small hole has opened in the shipwreck here. It is believed that fortune is hidden within it.
Underwater#004.dst: だが最近、この難破船に小さな穴が開いた。中に財宝が眠っていると言われている。
Underwater#004.speaker: Omango

Underwater#005.src: Unfortunately, nobody has been able to explore it. It is too deep, no creature can survive underwater that long!
Underwater#005.dst: 残念ながら、誰も探索できていない。深すぎて、そんなに長く水中にいられる生き物はいない！
Underwater#005.speaker: Omango

Underwater#006.src: However, my old friend Sayrr is a fisherman, and I know that he has a very special helmet...
Underwater#006.dst: だが旧友の Sayrr は漁師で、とても特別なヘルメットを持っているんだ…
Underwater#006.speaker: Omango

Underwater#007.src: If you convince him to give you this helmet, and find the treasure, I'll give you a part of it!
Underwater#007.dst: 彼を説得してヘルメットをもらい、宝を見つけたら、分け前をあげよう！
Underwater#007.speaker: Omango

Underwater#008.src: Sayrr is out on his boat, but the cave next to me is a quick way over to where he does his fishing. Be careful on the way, though.
Underwater#008.dst: Sayrr は船で沖に出ているが、隣の洞窟を通れば彼の釣り場まですぐだ。道中は気をつけて。
Underwater#008.speaker: Omango

Underwater#009.src: When you finally have the helmet, explore the ship and bring me back [{~} Ancient Treasure]. Good luck.
Underwater#009.dst: ヘルメットを手に入れたら船を探索し、[{~} Ancient Treasure] を持ち帰ってくれ。幸運を。
Underwater#009.speaker: Omango

Underwater#010.src: Go through the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find Sayrr on his boat on the other side
Underwater#010.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の洞窟を抜け、反対側の船にいる Sayrr を見つける

Underwater#011.src: Why ya looking at me like that? Is it cause I'm small, eh? I'll have you know that I caught fish that were twice your size!
Underwater#011.dst: なんだその目は？俺が小さいからか、ええ？言っとくが、お前の倍はある魚を釣ったことがあるんだぜ！
Underwater#011.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#012.src: ...or, well, I used to be able to. Nothing's biting recently- wait a sec, why'd you hop on my boat anyways, stranger?
Underwater#012.dst: …いや、昔は釣れたんだ。最近はさっぱり食いつかねえ―待て、そもそもなんで俺の船に乗ってきた？
Underwater#012.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#013.src: Ahah! Yes, I still have that old breathing helmet. You want it? You'll have to do something for me first.
Underwater#013.dst: あはっ！ああ、古い呼吸ヘルメットならまだある。欲しいのか？なら先に頼みを聞いてもらうぜ。
Underwater#013.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#014.src: I'm sure you heard me, but the fish just aren't biting around here anymore! I need to make a living somehow! There's some fish in that cave, but...
Underwater#014.dst: 聞こえてただろうが、この辺じゃもう魚が食いつかねえ！なんとか稼がなきゃならねえ！あの洞窟に魚はいるんだが…
Underwater#014.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#015.src: ...it's a bit dangerous. Tell ya what, I'll give you my fishing rod, and you can go catch me, say, [{~} Gudgeon Meat] down there.
Underwater#015.dst: …ちょっと危ねえんだ。そうだな、釣り竿を貸してやるから、下で [{~} Gudgeon Meat] でも釣ってきてくれ。
Underwater#015.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#016.src: The helmet will be all yours after that.
Underwater#016.dst: そしたらヘルメットはお前のもんだ。
Underwater#016.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#017.src: Bring back [{~} Gudgeon Meat] found in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to Sayrr
Underwater#017.dst: [{~} Gudgeon Meat] を Sayrr に持ち帰る ([-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の洞窟で入手)

Underwater#018.src: Ah! Welcome back! Any luck with the fish?
Underwater#018.dst: おう！おかえり！魚は釣れたか？
Underwater#018.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#019.src: Great, and I'll thank you kindly. Here's your helmet, have fun with that.
Underwater#019.dst: いいね、恩に着るぜ。ほらヘルメットだ、楽しめよ。
Underwater#019.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#020.src: Explore the crashed ship for a lost treasure at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Underwater#020.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の難破船を探索し、失われた宝を探す

Underwater#021.src: Break the crate and bring [{~} Old Treasure] to Omango at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Underwater#021.dst: 木箱を壊し、[{~} Old Treasure] を [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Omango に届ける

Underwater#022.src: You got it! You found the treasure!
Underwater#022.dst: やった！宝を見つけたんだね！
Underwater#022.speaker: Omango

Underwater#023.src: As promised, here's your part of the loot.
Underwater#023.dst: 約束通り、これが君の分け前だ。
Underwater#023.speaker: Omango
